Download **bambu-deck-0.1.6.streamDeckPlugin** and double-click it; Stream Deck installs the plugin along with its profiles.

- New starter profiles for every Stream Deck: one printer and its AMS, then what you reach for most: job info ("fertig um"), temperatures, AMS humidity, camera, "Steuern", preheat, light, speed and pause. The XL also has every temperature, the fans, home, unload, cool down and more
- No more keys for printers 2 to 4 in the starter profiles; add them from the action list if you have more printers
- New printers: X2D, A2L, H2C, H2D Pro and H3C (with AMS 3H), in the model list, the setup guide and the printer table. Pick the model by hand; their serial prefixes are not known yet. Camera: video first, then JPEG
